Evan — thanks for sending the PO and the routing link. Quick operational notes and an ask-list so we can process without delay: 

1) Net terms and credit: Redwood can extend Net60 for AtlasAI, Inc. subject to a standard billing review. For the EMEA entity we will invoice net30 by default unless Atlas provides a local treasury agreement; we can make an exception but it requires approval from finance. Expected turnaround: 48–72 hours for the credit check.

2) Required documents to complete onboarding for the split invoice: 
- W-9 for AtlasAI, Inc. (US payor)
- VAT registration certificate for AtlasAI EMEA Ltd (UK payor)
- PO 5509 with line-by-line allocation (we have the stub you attached but need the final signed PDF or DocuSign completion)

3) Invoice mapping: please confirm the chart of accounts or cost center strings if you want the invoices to include internal codes. Otherwise we will use the legal names and amounts provided on PO 5509.

4) Routing and payment instructions: 
- We can accept the single PO referencing ATLAS-AMND-03; please ensure the PO includes both legal names and amounts.
- For Net60 on the US payor there is no fee — just the standard credit review.
- For the EMEA split there may be a short-term collection hold until VAT evidence is validated.

I have attached a short note with our preferred billing fields and the payment portal link for invoice viewing. Once we have W-9 and VAT certificate we will finalize the billing setup and confirm DocuSign routing on our side so signatures can complete.

Attachments (attached): redwood-billing-instructions-5509.txt

If you prefer, we can run the credit review in parallel with DocuSign so we don't block the start of the renewal. What is your target effective date?

Thanks — Stephanie
